Supreme Court Criticizes Election Commission Over Lost Karnataka Vote Count Video

The Supreme Court has criticized the Election Commission of India (EC) for its inability to locate a video related to vote counting in the 2023 Karnataka elections. The court rejected what it termed "lame excuses" from the EC. The case involves an appeal by Congress candidate T D Rajegowda, who won the election by a narrow margin of 201 votes. The court's criticism arose from the EC's claim that it had lost the vote count video.
